mapper.sql: c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.level, c.sort, c.status, coalesce(g.goods_count, 0) as goods_count, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.create_user, c.update_user
mapper.select:
select
from category c left join ( select category_id, count(1) as goods_count from goods group by category_id ) g on c.id = g.category_id where c.id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into category ( parent_id, name, level, sort, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user ) values ( #{parentId}, #{name}, #{level}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser} )
mapper.update:
